description.text: Research Direction Theory and Methods in Product Design Visual Communication Design Animation and Digital Design Certificate Granting Students are required to complete the curriculum, fullfill the designated number of credits, complete the master thesis and defend of it. Successful graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with MFA (Master of Fine Arts).

duration.text: The Design Arts at Harbin Engineering University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5069 USD/per year ￥ 36500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Foreign citizens, in good health. 2.A Bachelor Degree in related courses. 3.language proficiency: TOFEL 550 or more, or IELTS 6.0 or more, or provide other Engslish proficiency certificate (the student, who is from English countries or his/her mother language is English, needn’t submit the English proficiency certificate).
